The deposition testimony should be ruled admissible. The engineer is unavailable, so FRE 804(b)(1) (former testimony) applies. The company was a party to the earlier wrongful termination suit, where it deposed the engineer and had the opportunity and a similar motive to examine him on whether it filed false safety reports. That is all the rule requires of the party against whom the testimony is offered, so the pilot's absence from the first suit doesn't matter and the company's objection should be overruled.

CONFIDENCE: 82
